summary: Alleghany County, VA lookout site; 40-foot wooden CT-2 tower built by the Forest Service in 1939, removed before 2011; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 40' wooden CT-2 tower with 14'x14' wooden cab, wooden catwalk and shingle roof
facts.status_note: Former Fire Lookout Sites says removed before 2011; Forest Fire Lookout Association's Virginia list shows Tower Gone

events.note: Constructed by the U.S. Forest Service
Date registered April 10, 2011; nominated by Ron Stafford

corrections.why: The Removed field reads 'before 2011'; 2011 is the registration year, not a removal year

notes_for_editor: Only the Former Fire Lookout Sites record and one state-list entry describe this site. The Forest Lookouts Brushy Mountain (Alleghany) page on easternuslookouts.weebly.com has only a heading and a forest line. Two other cached pages labelled Brushy Mountain were not used: brushy-mountain.html describes a West Virginia tower (Greenbrier/Monroe), and brushy-mountain1.html is the Allen Field tower in Montgomery County. The Wikipedia article on Brushy Mountain (conservation area) describes the wildland, not a tower. No staffing or fire sources found. Access left out because no source describes it.
